blocks.p: Our terms and conditions are being finalised and will be published here before FLIQ becomes generally available.
In the meantime, our privacy policy describes how we handle your personal data, and we're happy to answer any question about the terms directly at info@fliqpayments.com.
FLIQ is a payment initiation service operated by Avanoro AB.
How we process personal data is described separately in our {privacy}.
